nodes.label: Tycho Brahe
nodes.description: Collected extremely precise astronomical observations without a telescope.

nodes.label: Johannes Kepler
nodes.description: Used Brahe's data to derive the laws of planetary motion.

nodes.label: Isaac Newton
nodes.description: Explained Kepler's laws using universal gravitation.

nodes.label: Elliptical Orbits
nodes.description: Planets move in ellipses with the Sun at one focus.
